description: Recognizable bicycle components in black line art: wheels (circular), frame (rectangles), handlebars (lines), seat (ellipse), pedals (lines), and chain (line between two points).

drawing_instructions.composition: Place the wheels at opposite sides of the frame, handlebars and seat in a central position above the wheels. Include pedals attached to one wheel.
drawing_instructions.intent: Draw a bicycle without labels. Focus on recognizable components such as wheels, handlebars, seat, frame, and pedals.
